description_html.value:
Academic focus

This MSc applies scientific methods to archaeological questions and evidence.

Curriculum and research

Core teaching includes scientific dating, molecular bioarchaeology and materials analysis. Students complete a five-month research project and attend lectures, classes, laboratory sessions and seminars.

Facilities and next steps

Students use School of Archaeology workspace and laboratory facilities. Oxford lists further research, archaeological project work and heritage-related careers among graduate destinations.
